messages:
Samira: Quick follow-up from the arch huddle 1 we're converging on putting most precision "opinions" in the model manifest, but want to discuss granularity and runtime safety knobs. High-level notes below.
Noah: Agree with manifest canonicality. Two areas to call out: (1) per-layer/head exceptions (some layers explode under 4bit), (2) hysteresis controls so we don't flip-flop on early-fallbacks.
Priyanka: Proposal: manifest fields include precision_candidates, degradation_budget, precision_lifetime, hysteresis_window_ms, per_namespace_exceptions (list of selectors), quality_anchor_digest, and regen_policy. Also add a "degradation_trajectory" hint (expected quality delta vs token position) so runtime can anticipate long-tail drift.
Jorge: Love the trajectory hint. Example use: if model shows gradual deg over tokens 50-200 for fp8, runtime can preemptively switch at token 45 rather than waiting for threshold, avoiding visible artifacts.
Samira: Important for Dedicated/Private: manifests must be signed + allow an admin "lease" to grant a tenant a precision override for a limited time (precision_lease_expires). That solves per-tenant SLAs without permanent divergence.
Noah: Hysteresis detail: two params: hysteresis_window_ms and hysteresis_count (min consecutive triggers). Combined they prevent flapping when degscore briefly spikes. Also add a cooldown_ms after any fallback where we won't fallback again.
Priyanka: Streaming UX: two fallback modes: SWITCH_NO_REGEN (just change precision for subsequent tokens) and SWITCH_WITH_BUFFERED_REGEN (attempt to regenerate last K tokens once stream ends). Add REGENERATE_OPT_IN flag clients can set per-request. Default hosted policy = SWITCH_NO_REGEN.
Jorge: For ops, include cheap smoke artifact: quality_anchor_digest + bloom-like quick-check to detect obvious deviations in canaries. Keep the artifact small (<= 128 bytes) so canary runs are cheap.
Samira: Edge-case: per-layer exceptions can blow up the compiler if expressed naively. Use selectors like "layer:attn_kv,shape:1024x64" or "module:feedforward,headwise:top8" so compiler can resolve at compile-time and fall back to safe kernels.
Noah: Add manifest guidance for approximate latency_delta_ms and cost_multiplier per precision so console can show tradeoffs and product can enforce budget policies.
Priyanka: Observability: emit events: MANIFEST_LOADED, OVERRIDE_REQUESTED, OVERRIDE_REJECTED_REASON, EARLY_FALLBACK_TRIGGER, FALLBACK_COOLDOWN_ENTERED, REGEN_ATTEMPTED. Maintain counters per manifest version and per-tenant.
Jorge: Security/migration: when a new manifest tightens degradation_budget, honor previous overrides until precision_lease_expires. For forced tightening, require admin ack in Dedicated/Private.
Samira: Action items: Priyanka 5 define manifest schema + sample selectors and degradation_trajectory format. Noah 5 design hysteresis/cooldown semantics and unit tests. Jorge 5 draft admin lease flow + signing requirements for private installs. I'll assemble a short RFC with examples and a canary checklist tomorrow. :thumbsup:
